name: Syzygus
title: Paul's Faithful Fellow Worker
summary: Syzygus was a fellow worker in the church at Philippi whom Paul mentions in his letter. His name means 'true yokefellow' or 'faithful companion,' and Paul asked him to help reconcile Euodia and Syntyke, two women who had been in conflict with each other.

keyEvents.title: Encouragement to Help the Women
keyEvents.description: Paul addressed Syzygus directly and asked him to help Euodia and Syntyke agree in the Lord, since they had struggled alongside Paul in the service of the gospel.

keyEvents.title: Recognition as a Faithful Fellow Worker
keyEvents.description: Paul called him his 'true yokefellow,' which shows a close and trusting relationship between them in their church work.
